title: Multi-Pass Turning on a short neck window reports false rest

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
Found during #2865. Related catalog work: #2392.

Base: upstream/main `58cb641ca`.

Use original closed meshes. Revolve each listed `(radius, Z)` meridian about Z with 48 angular segments.
Use `assets/machines/lathe.mch` and the `Fanuc Lathe` post.
Import the blank as stock with `set_stock {from_model: ...}`.
Set `set_raw_stock_only {on: true}`. Keep all verification checks active.

## What happens

Multi-Pass Turning roughs a neck in a short axial window.
Generation succeeds. Verification blocks the post:

```text
finish envelope near move 235: 0.0073 mm gouge, 2.2543 mm rest
```

## Reproduce

The finished meridian is:

```text
(0,0), (8,0), (10,2), (10,12), (9,12), (9,40), (8,60), (0,60)
```

The blank meridian is:

```text
(0,0), (10,0), (10,12), (9,12), (9,40), (8,60), (0,60)
```

Use `TN-1600-0R8` and the finished model as source.
Create these operations in order:

1. Chamfering: fixed clearance 70, top 2, bottom 0, angle 45 degrees.
2. Taper Turning: fixed clearance 70, top 60, bottom 40, diameters 18 and 16.
3. Multi-Pass Turning: fixed clearance 70, top 20, bottom 2.

For Multi-Pass Turning, use stepdown 0.5, stock allowance 0.25 and three passes.
Use tolerance 0.05, feed 120 and plunge feed 40 for all three operations.
Generate, then call `verify`.

The first two operations have separate completion warnings.
The multi-pass operation also has the quoted independent warning.

The original bushing attempt had more outside features and a blind bore.
It produced the same 2.2543 mm rest value near move 387.

## Expected result

The operation must judge its promised window and 0.25 mm allowance.
Other model regions must not add rest to that promise.

## Passing comparison

This simpler finished meridian verifies and posts:

```text
(0,0), (8,0), (10,2), (10,12), (9,12), (9,60), (0,60)
```

Use a diameter 20 blank over Z0..60.
Create Chamfering over Z0..2, then Multi-Pass Turning over the full Z0..60.
Keep tolerance 0.05, stepdown 0.5, allowance 0.25, three passes and 48 angular segments.

This comparison changes the model and operation window.
It does not identify which change avoids the refusal.
Related issue #2880 concerns Profile Finish on necks and threads.

Effort: high. The fix changes a verification rule and has the safety floor.

Done means: A test reproduces this refusal. The valid operation verifies and posts. Real gouges and unfinished promised surfaces still block posting.
